title: ELEV8R Quartz Replacement Heater
description:
ELEV8R Quartz Replacement Heater
This replacement quartz heater is for the Elev8r. Each Elev8r heater is hand crafted by Elev8’s skilled glass artisans straight out of Colorado Springs.
The use of quartz in the elev8r heater takes the durability of this piece to a whole new level. The shinning feature of quartz is its ability to withstand rapid changes in temperature without cracking. And while quartz is more expensive to buy to begin with it just may save you money in the long run.
Included
1 x Replacement Quartz Elev8r Heater
